plugins.name: session-handover
plugins.description: Reincarnation-style handover/takeover for Claude Code. Each agent self-names with an English first name and keeps an identity-scoped document at <base>/<name>.md, with a YAML frontmatter `description` field (the worker's stable job description) followed by a curated Knowledge block (stock) and an append-only History block (flow). The frontmatter lets `/takeover` list candidates by job description without reading the body. <base> is resolved deterministically by the bundled `handover-dir` command (on the Bash tool's PATH while the plugin is enabled), which walks up from cwd to the nearest .handover/ directory and falls back to $HOME/.handover when none is found. v2.x users are auto-migrated: when `handover-dir` finds a legacy `.claude/handover/` on the walk-up path, it lifts it to `.handover/` at the same level on first use. v3.0.x documents without frontmatter are still selectable in `/takeover` (description rendered as `(no description)`) and gain a `description` field the next time their owner runs `/handover`. A successor takes over an identity to inherit its memory, understanding, and experience.
plugins.author: lacolaco
